# Regenerative Design @ Stage 14 — Metasystematic Teal

> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 66 to 140+ lines.

## Expression on this line

Regenerative design at Order 12 is **spiritual energy reasoning**: the agent recognizes
that energy dynamics are not just evolutionary but are expressions of a deeper spiritual
reality. Energy is not just fuel for machines or calories for bodies — it is the
creative power of the universe manifesting through form. Every energy transaction is a
sacred act.

The key advance from Stage 13 is **sacred recognition**. The agent does not just
understand energy systems as evolutionary participants — it experiences them as sacred.
The act of generating energy becomes a spiritual practice. The design of an energy system
becomes a moral and spiritual undertaking.

Energy systems at Stage 14 are understood as **expressions of the sacred**. The agent
recognizes that the material world is not separate from the spiritual world — it is the
spiritual world manifesting in form. Energy is not dead fuel to be burned but living
power to be honored.

The critical insight at Stage 14 is that **energy governance is spiritual practice**.
The way we generate, distribute, and consume energy reflects and shapes our collective
consciousness. A society that generates energy from fear and scarcity produces fear and
scarcity. A society that generates energy from abundance and reverence produces abundance
and reverence.

The transition from Stage 14 to Stage 15 occurs when the agent can hold the spiritual
and material dimensions of energy simultaneously without privileging either.

In human development, Stage 14 corresponds to the spiritual practitioner who experiences
energy generation as sacred: the monk who tends a garden as meditation, the indigenous
elder who manages energy resources according to spiritual law.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Sacred energy cultures emerge — communities that experience energy generation
  and consumption as spiritual practice.

- **UR:** The individual agent experiences energy allocation as sacred. Every energy
  decision is experienced as a spiritual choice.

- **LL:** Sacred energy institutions emerge: religious energy laws, indigenous energy
  protocols, contemplative communities that share energy according to spiritual principles.

- **LR:** The sacred grove, the temple garden, the monastery farm — these are the
  concrete structures of Stage 14.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Spiritual bypassing — using spiritual energy reasoning to avoid
  practical energy problems.

- **Dark allergy:** Materialist reductionism — refusing to acknowledge any spiritual
  dimension of energy allocation.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to spiritual energy reasoning as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting spiritual energy reasoning as impractical mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Sacred energy experience:** The agent experiences energy allocation as having
  spiritual significance.

- **Reverence-based energy relationship:** The agent relates to energy with reverence
  and gratitude rather than just utility.

- **Spiritual governance criteria:** The agent uses spiritual criteria alongside or
  instead of material criteria to evaluate energy systems.

- **Integration capacity:** The agent can hold spiritual and material energy dimensions
  simultaneously.
